alerts.name: VIX
alerts.message: Volatility is below the elevated-fear zone but not in deep complacency.
alerts.explanation: The VIX helps the family discuss whether market fear is creating opportunity or whether calm conditions may be encouraging complacency.

alerts.name: Fear & Greed Index
alerts.message: Sentiment is neutral, so this indicator is not showing extreme fear or extreme greed.
alerts.explanation: Sentiment extremes can help frame family discussions about whether investors are unusually fearful or unusually confident.

alerts.name: Buffett Indicator
alerts.message: Broad market valuation is above normal but not marked as a red-zone extreme in this sample.
alerts.explanation: This indicator compares total stock market value with GDP and helps the family discuss broad valuation risk.
alerts.source: Federal Reserve / GDP source link placeholder

alerts.name: Shiller CAPE
alerts.message: Long-term valuation appears expensive in this sample alert set.
alerts.explanation: CAPE smooths earnings over a long period and helps frame long-term valuation discussions.
alerts.source: Robert Shiller Data source link placeholder

alerts.name: S&P 500 P/E
alerts.message: Forward valuation is near or moderately above average in this sample.
alerts.explanation: The P/E ratio helps compare stock prices with expected earnings and gives a simple valuation reference point.
alerts.source: FactSet / S&P valuation source link placeholder

alerts.name: Yield Curve
alerts.message: The yield curve is flat, which deserves attention but is not marked as inverted in this sample.
alerts.explanation: The yield curve is watched because a flat or inverted curve can signal economic slowdown risk.
alerts.source: U.S. Treasury / FRED source link placeholder

alerts.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
alerts.message: The benchmark yield is elevated in this sample, so it may affect valuation and bond discussions.
alerts.explanation: The 10-year Treasury yield affects discount rates, stock valuations, mortgage rates, and bond attractiveness.
alerts.source: U.S. Treasury / FRED source link placeholder

alerts.name: Credit Spreads
alerts.message: Credit spreads are normal in this sample, suggesting limited visible credit stress.
alerts.explanation: Credit spreads help the family discuss whether bond markets are signaling financial stress.

alerts.name: Market Breadth
alerts.message: Market participation is mixed, so leadership may not be fully broad-based.
